Stealing a car in GTA 6 does not make it yours. Here is how keeping vehicles works in our test save.

Chapter 1 – You can't change your personal car yet

During Chapter 1 you can't change your personal vehicle, but you can steal any vehicle off the street.

Chapter 2 – Register cars with Moses

After you meet Moses in Chapter 2, you can bring him any car that doesn't have a tracker and click Register in his garage.

Chapter 3 – More tools

You automatically get the key cloner in Chapter 3 during the mission "Steal the Zorruso".

Early in Chapter 3 you can register stolen vehicles that have Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
